errors.text: The predicted sign is reversed: the target finds an approximately 12% increase in lattice thermal conductivity with SRO, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts suppression.
The proposed DAPB phonon-scattering mechanism omits the target mechanisms of reduced lattice distortion, B2-like HfTi/TiZr ordering, and high-conductivity percolation pathways.
The cited evidence concerns dislocation mobility in MoNbTaW and does not establish any effect of SRO on phonon or lattice thermal transport.
Laser-flash measurement of total thermal conductivity does not by itself isolate lattice conductivity from the substantial electronic contribution in metallic RHEAs.
